system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: DebugMate employs structured prompt templates based on ReAct and Tree-of-Thought methodologies.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Uses advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to locate and return the most relevant documentation and knowledge base entries.
env_context_strategy.note: embedding RAG plus agent-driven code search/navigation tools

context_compaction.evidence_quote: When a function or class is too large for direct retrieval, the agent receives only the focused function body. If the content still exceeds the token limit, DebugMate dynamically prompts the user to paste a reduced version

observation_format.evidence_quote: the tool output, is collectively passed back into the LLM as the next input

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Prompts follow a "Thought - Action - Action Input" format, which facilitates agent planning, tool invocation
tool_call_format.note: ReAct text format; branch action input is a JSON string

tool_count.evidence_quote: Code Search ... Online Developer Portal (DP) Search ... Internal Knowledge-base (KB) Search ... Graph Understanding Tool ... Git Metadata
tool_count.note: 5 context tools plus the ToT Tool = 6; Path Tool is internal to Code Search

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Implementing functionality to modify code and test fixes in real-time, as seen in other debugging tools [ 3], could also be explored.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: along with descriptions of the tools available, ensuring the agent receives all necessary context

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: In this section, we outline the library of tools we built out to gather organization context.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: DebugMate employs a depth-first search to explore code modules ordered by priority.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: structured and systematic self-planning to navigate through complex production systems

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: an AI Agent that uniquely integrates an organization’s internal context with external knowledge sources.
multi_agent_topology.note: Described as a single agent; Tree-of-Thoughts branching is reasoning-level, not multiple agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The ToT tool orders the modules to be searched based on priority, and instantiates a new agent for every branch.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: optionally ask for user input at key turning points of the search execution, such as when creating branches with low confidence scores
human_in_loop.note: default is black-box; user gating optional

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
Leveraging both short-term memory to retain important insights from previous
thoughts
short_term_state.note: Short-term memory of insights from previous thoughts; mechanism not specified, closest value scratchpad.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: long-term memory to store valuable information like code dependencies and class hierarchies
long_term_memory.note: RAG pipeline with OpenAI embeddings over internal docs

self_verification.evidence_quote: After each branch reaches its conclusion, the parent agent evaluates if it should be added to its list of hypotheses.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the agent decides to end the search and return the final response with a list of hypotheses generated so far

rollback.evidence_quote: Implementing functionality to modify code and test fixes in real-time, as seen in other debugging tools [ 3], could also be explored.
rollback.note: no code modification, so nothing to roll back

termination_condition.evidence_quote: In case the current branch concludes with a high confidence score, the agent decides to end the search and return the final response

cost_controls.evidence_quote: ensuring token efficiency while maintaining contextual fidelity
cost_controls.note: token efficiency mentioned but no budget/cache/routing mechanism described

timeouts.evidence_quote: The process took 183 s on average.
timeouts.note: timing measured, no enforced timeout described

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Future development could involve adding code execution capabilities and access to API endpoints
filesystem_access.note: agent only searches/reads code and docs

network_policy.evidence_quote: Queries search engines with specific issue details, utilizing results from platforms like StackOverflow

permission_model.evidence_quote: function as a black box and provide the user with a final list of hypotheses from a single user query

tracing.evidence_quote: We also recorded debugging time, the depth of code modules investigated, and the usage of each tool provided to the agent.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The full set of results and code can be accessed on our GitHub repository
eval_hooks.note: evaluated on DebugBench and internal incidents; runner presence not explicitly stated

guardrails.evidence_quote: safety rules such as requiring multiple branches for ambiguous root causes, rejecting vague inputs for code queries, and enforcing a minimum context-gathering cycle before hypothesis generation

target_domain.evidence_quote: an AI Agent that uniquely integrates an organization's internal context with external knowledge sources

open_source.evidence_quote: All open-source experiments conducted during this study are available to ensure transparency and reproducibility.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: In this paper, we introduce DebugMate
